list.title: Waibu#_handleAppHook
list.description: Handle app hooks. It will run hooks for each web app and main app.

list.title: Waibu#_handleFavicon
list.description:
Create route for '/favicon.:ext'

Location of favicon file can be found in:

  1. main plugin's file; if not found, then
  2. site attachment; if not found, then
  3. static dir of theme; if not found, then
  4. default plugin's file

list.title: Waibu#_handleForward
list.description: Handle forward. It will decorate reply object with forwardTo method.

list.title: Waibu#_handleHome
list.description: Create route for '/' to redirect to home path.

list.title: Waibu#_handleRedirect
list.description: Handle redirect. It will decorate reply object with redirectTo method.

list.title: Waibu#_handleRobotsTxt
list.description:
Create route for '/robots.txt'.

Location of robots.txt file can be found in:

  1. main plugin's file; if not found, then
  2. site attachment; if not found, then
  3. default plugin's file

list.title: Waibu#fetch
list.description: Fetch something from url. A wrapper of bajo-extra's fetchUrl which support bajo's ns based url.

list.title: Waibu#getIp
list.description: Get visitor IP from fastify's request object

list.title: Waibu#isIntlPath
list.description: Is namespace's path contains language detector token?

list.title: Waibu#parseFilter
list.description: Parse filter found from Fastify's request based on keys set in config object

list.title: Waibu#qs
list.description: Query string parser and stringifier. It is a wrapper of {@link https://www.npmjs.com/package/query-string|query-string} package.

list.title: Waibu#routePath
list.description:
Get route path by route's name:

  • If it is a mailto: or tel: url, it returns as is
  • If it starts with :/, name will be prefixed with its ns automatically
  • If it is a ns based name, it will be parsed first

list.title: download
list.description: Helper to handle file download. It will set proper content-type based on file extension.

list.title: factory
list.description:
Plugin factory.

Never call this function directly!!! It's only-meant to be called by the {@link https://ardhi.github.io/bajo|Bajo framework} during plugin initialization.
